title: Viridian_City
lead_summary:
Viridian City is the first town the player encounters after exiting Route 1. The paths West to Route 22 and North to Route 2 (Before the Forest) will be blocked until Oak received his Parcel.
The Gym will be closed until Team Rocket has been defeated on Mt. Ember.

}}'''Viridian City''' is the first town the player encounters after exiting [[Route 1]]. The paths West to [[Route 22]] and North to [[Route 2 (Before the Forest)]] will be blocked until Oak received his Parcel.

The Gym will be closed until Team Rocket has been defeated on [[Mt. Ember]].
